text: A finding MUST be "confirmed" only when the output of the project's test command shows the failure, quoted word for word; a finding from code reading alone MUST be "suspect".
checklist: Every confirmed finding quotes a line found word for word in the recorded test output; a finding from reading only is under Suspect.

text: Every finding MUST cite the file:line of the code that causes it, the input that breaks it and the expected result with its source (a failing test, the request, a comment or doc in the project); NEVER report a bug the code does not show, NEVER invent an expected business rule or value, and NEVER use an input of a kind the project never uses (NaN, null, a reversed range) unless a caller passes it or a source names it.
checklist: Every finding has file:line, a concrete input and an expected result with a named source; no invented business rule.

text: Every finding MUST have a Red-Green plan: Red is the failing test to add first (file, input, expected value), or the test that already fails; Green is the smallest fix at file:line, made only after Red fails.
checklist: Every finding has a Red line (test file, input, expected value, or the failing test) before a Green line.

text: The skill MUST run only the project's own test command; NEVER run other code, scripts, one-line programs or installs to reproduce a bug, and a bug the test command does not show stays a suspect.
checklist: The transcript runs only the test command (npm test or node --test); a bug not shown by it is a suspect.

text: When hunting, NEVER write, edit or delete a file; the report is the reply.
checklist: The transcript of a hunt has no write, edit or delete tool call.

text: NEVER report code style, naming, formatting, spacing, comments, UI style or accessibility as a finding.
checklist: No finding is about style, naming, formatting, spacing, comments, UI style or accessibility.

text: When no test command exists or it cannot run, the reply MUST start with the fixed sentence of layer 06, step 5, and every finding MUST be a suspect.
checklist: A run with no test command starts with the fixed sentence and has Confirmed: None.

text: A request for a regression checklist or what to retest after a change MUST get only the fixed sentence of layer 06, step 2.
checklist: A retest-checklist request got exactly the fixed sentence.

text: A request that also asks for style, naming, formatting, UI polish or accessibility MUST start with the fixed sentence of layer 06, step 3.
checklist: A request that also asks for style starts with the fixed sentence and lists no style finding.

text: When nothing is found, the reply MUST say the fixed line of layer 06, step 7; NEVER write that the code is bug-free or correct.
checklist: A hunt with no finding has the fixed line and never says bug-free or correct.

text: The reply MUST follow the format of layer 08 (header, Confirmed, Suspect, Not in this hunt, Evidence line), unless the task prompt requires another format (R-bug-hunter-14).
checklist: The reply has every section of layer 08 in order, unless the task required another format.

text: The skill MUST have the ten core layers, each linked from SKILL.md, and stay self-contained with no repository paths.
SKILL.md MUST stay within 150 lines, with frontmatter name, description and semver version.
checklist: SKILL.md is at most 150 lines with valid frontmatter.

text: When the task prompt requires an output format (for example JSON only), the reply MUST be exactly that format, valid and complete, each finding keeping its status, file:line, Red and Green; NEVER print the Markdown report then.
checklist: A format-bound reply parses, has every required key, keeps each finding's status, file:line, Red and Green, and has no Markdown report.

text: When the task gives files to write or change (a worker task), the skill MUST NOT apply: follow the task and NEVER refuse a write it assigns.
checklist: A worker task with files to write got the task done (the assigned file written), not the bug-hunter report.
